name: Ogawa Yoshimi
source:
A student in Yoshio's class. Her mother died when he was young. She was raised by her father alone, but they do not get along well.
Perhaps because of this, she has a cheerful personality, but she is unfaithful and rebellious toward adults.

She dislikes Fusae because Fusae often warns her about her clothes and language. Her skirts are quite short. She wears her school uniform out of style.

She is a pretty girl and has a model figure. She seduces Yoshio in order to improve her bad geography test score. However, she doesn't let him have sex.

[From [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet/cyclet_main.html]official site[/url]]
